correctness.rationale: The dimension-preserving action has no inversions. Solomon–Tits supplies a simply connected 2-complex; Armstrong kills the entire acting group in the quotient fundamental group since each element fixes L. The invariant-subspace lattices for identity, nonidentity base-field scalars, and elements of degree three have fixed-complex Euler characteristics 1+q^6, 1+q^3, and 2, respectively. In the second and third cases the two summands split every invariant subspace by coprime minimal polynomials. Averaging over 1, q−2, and q^3−q elements gives 1+q^3+q, including q=2 when the middle class is empty. H_2 is free by dimension, and a Hurewicz basis yields the claimed integral homotopy equivalence by simply connected Whitehead. Independently, the poset of subspaces meeting W is equivariantly contractible via U≥U∩W≤W. Collapsing its image leaves suspensions of the links of the two orbits of complementary lines: one free orbit contributes q^3 spheres and the fixed line contributes q, since the plane-building quotient of W has two vertices and q+1 incidence edges.
residual_risks: Numerical enumeration is for q=2,3 only; the topology for general prime powers is analytic.
